scientific_integrity: The general product feasibility framework and cycle polynomial precede this result and are credited. Claims of originality concern the rectangular enumerator and the three random-placement limits, not the underlying methods.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic laws assume independent identically distributed Bernoulli placements and square boards; no claim is made for rectangular aspect limits or correlated failures. Finite verification complements analytic proofs. Literature-priority uncertainty remains for unindexed equivalent results.
title: Exact restrained-domination enumeration and three random-placement windows for rook graphs
